signals.usability_note: Clear view of a two-story colonial-style house set back behind a large lawn, seen from across a cul-de-sac or street bend. The house is partly shaded by trees and is some distance from the camera.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Foundation shrubs and a neatly mowed lawn are visible, but there is no crew, equipment, or other clear sign of professional service.

signals.notes: A gray minivan is parked on the street near the driveway apron, and a white vehicle is partly visible near the house; a basketball hoop and a swing set in the neighboring yard suggest a family neighborhood.
